speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To evaluate your sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down the leg, please tell me: on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the pain, and does it radiate below your knee?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression).

The symptoms of sudden onset, sharp lower back pain radiating down the leg and foot into the foot are classic for a herniated disc. Given the patient is a young, active woman, this is highly consistent with an acute disc injury from exercise. No further questions or tests are required for this clinical picture.
